changes_made.issue_claim: The criminal provisions sit alongside existing Title 18 offenses; takedown-notice provisions are codified at 47 U.S.C. § 223a
changes_made.new_content: Revised codification paragraph to: 'The Act's criminal prohibition is codified at 47 U.S.C. § 223(h) (added by the Act to the Communications Act), and the platform notice-and-removal obligation is codified at 47 U.S.C. § 223a. The Act supplements — but does not reside in — existing Title 18 offenses targeting nonconsensual intimate imagery and cyberstalking.' Added hyperlink to 47 U.S.C. § 223 at Cornell LII. Added a new entry in Sources list for § 223.

changes_made.issue_claim: Platforms have until May 19, 2026 to comply, with FTC enforcement authority under the Federal Trade Commission Act (hyperlink mismatch)
changes_made.new_content: Changed the hyperlink target from https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/47/223a to https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/15/45 (FTC Act Section 5). Updated anchor text to 'Section 5 of the Federal Trade Commission Act'. Added matching Sources entry for 15 U.S.C. § 45.

changes_made.issue_claim: The TAKE IT DOWN Act (S. 146, 119th Congress) was passed on April 28, 2025
changes_made.new_content: Revised sentence to: 'The TAKE IT DOWN Act (S. 146, 119th Congress) passed the House on April 28, 2025 (after Senate passage on February 13, 2025) and was signed into law on May 19, 2025.'
